reviewed_by: Codex; independent diagnosis of database blocking, harness-list cost, and goal runtime authority before implementation
reason: Focused async database and recovery contracts on SQLite/PostgreSQL, real Core auth/chat/listing/Butler-memory entry points, bounded pools, revisions/events/claims, cancellation, runtime-switch activation and compaction consent, indexed harness title seeks, additive rollback, and frozen-driver dependencies. Includes 25 existing storage cases, 14 selected existing recovery/tool cases and one existing action-ledger case. Three UI mapping cases are selected. Additional runtime-switch regressions preserve later metadata and reject invalidated settings or dependency revisions; auxiliary SQLite tests reject synchronous drivers on the event loop. The selected CI job provisions PostgreSQL for its eight existing database cases and fails clearly if configuration is absent; it does not broaden test scope. Nine additional cases exercise callback failures, repeated shutdown cancellation, purger rollback, serial auxiliary budgets, single-flight queue position reads, cache expiry and uncommitted session isolation. Seven existing API/CLI/WebSocket/scheduler cases validate the migrated caller and test-loop boundaries; four product-index cases verify its current digest, discoverability and Chroma synchronization. The selected frozen Linux job builds the real distribution and executes exactly two owned database journeys, with a non-administrative PostgreSQL role. Eight focused admission cases cover failed/cancelled release, repeated cancellation, stale lease fencing, both-database postcommit cancellation, completed-token ownership and recovery-slot cleanup. Six existing restart/ownership cases are rerun after this change.
exclusions: No full suites. The 24-case production LAN browser matrix passed in CI. Bundled product knowledge and a frozen executable remain to be verified on hosted CI because local model/runtime downloads are denied. Chat admission performance acceptance remains open; final matched measurements follow the polling and query-shape repairs. Remaining repository diagnostic/test callers are being migrated.
